blocker.detail: Implemented the R15 database migration, rollback, invariant SQL, catalog/dictionary sync, and contract tests. Static/contract validation passes, but this worker cannot execute the required real PostgreSQL Flyway empty/upgrade/invariant run because psql and docker are not on PATH, HHY_DB_MIGRATION_TEST_URL/HHY_DB_SMOKE_CONFIRM are not configured, and the Maven wrapper fails before startup with 'Cannot index into a null array' / 'Cannot start maven from wrapper'.
